husumContext.title: Husum facility-area marker and course end; no shoreline connector

findings: The original main-stem anchor lies in the White Salmon gorge east of BZ Corner. The rejected nearest unnamed edge follows a roadside tributary through town.

All nine overlapping course contexts and both endpoint views inspected. Source follows the continuous White Salmon valley/gorge; no known former-channel or wooded-island shortcut identified. Tree cover and shadow obscure portions of the narrow channel, so the line is only a generalized river-course overview.

Husum facility context and current USFS description retained. The source course ends near the unchanged roadside boating-area marker. It does not locate the actual take-out eddy or certify that a user will exit before Husum Falls.
Original source vertices retained. No shoreline connector, rapid-by-rapid passage, bank claim, navigation guidance, planning-distance replacement or remaining-time feature enabled.
